entry.title: SAP4U “Meet the Speaker” Kristen Scheffler Maximizing Your S/4HANA Investment: Post-Go-Live
entry.content:
Hopefully you are traveling to San Antonio for SAP for Utilities next month and will make time for Kristen Scheffler's sessions below.

Register here

Here are her session details:

Maximizing Your S/4HANA Investment: Post-Go-Live Optimization & Insights

This two-part, hands-on session is designed to help SAP customers unlock greater value from their S/4HANA environments—both immediately after go-live and throughout ongoing operations.

Part 1: https://events.asug.com/event/sap-for-utilities-2026/agenda?session=9baf0122-79f5-4f90-b39d-3529203a...
Part 2: https://events.asug.com/event/sap-for-utilities-2026/agenda?session=aeda8cac-4630-4497-b4cc-f2f4ce95...

Session 1 : Enhancing Your S/4HANA Landscape Post Go-Live
The journey doesn’t end at go-live—this session focuses on how to continuously optimize and innovate your S/4HANA environment using SAP’s embedded tools and services. Learn how to leverage SAP Signavio Process Insights, discovery edition to identify process inefficiencies and benchmark performance across key business areas using data-driven recommendations.
We’ll also explore how SAP Readiness Check provides deep system insights and helps mitigate risks while planning future upgrades or transformations.


Discover how Continuous Quality Checks (CQCs) connect you with SAP experts to deliver actionable recommendations based on real system data, enabling ongoing improvement and stability.

Additionally, we will highlight key enablement resources such as the Onboarding Resource Center and Release Navigator for SAP Cloud ERP, which provide curated guidance, release visibility, and structured content to accelerate feature adoption and user readiness.

Session 2 : Driving Transparency & Value with SAP for Me
In the second half, we shift focus to SAP for Me—your central entry point for managing and optimizing your SAP landscape. Learn how to proactively configure cloud availability notifications to stay ahead of planned maintenance and system events.
We’ll walk through the Customer Insights Dashboard and demonstrate how to gain visibility into critical metrics, including:

  • Product usage and adoption trends
  • Maintenance timelines and lifecycle planning
  • License consumption and optimization opportunities
  • Cloud performance and service health
  • Learning and enablement consumption

By the end of each session, you will have practical insights and tools to enhance operational transparency, improve decision-making, and ensure you are fully leveraging your SAP investment.

Get to Know Kristen:

Kristen Scheffler

 

 Kristen Scheffler is Vice President Customer Engagement for North America, within SAP’s Customer Evolution team.   She is responsible for leading a team focused on engaging with SAP customers to assist and educate them on the value of their SAP investments, helping them with their business case to becoming an intelligent, sustainable enterprise, as well as driving utilization of support services across their landscape. Kristen has been with SAP for over 20 years, starting out with Business Objects (BOBJ for those familiar with the term). 

Levi

 

Outside of work, Kristen enjoys listening to a variety of music and getting her daily steps in with her husky, Levi. (attached pic of Levi)

I hope you make time to attend Kristen's sessions.

Register today

entry.title: Re: 30 Years SAP Certification, Countless Journeys: Share Your #MySAPCertificationStory
entry.content:
#MyCertificationStory

After my first SAP project, I joined a consulting firm and asked if I could attend the SAP Academy for certification. My boss said "why don't you take the test first and we'll see".  At the time I read the entire SAP Help for FI (Finance).  I flew from New York to Boston to take the test in Waltham, MA and passed the exam.  I followed the same approach for CO (Controlling) - I just read the SAP Help and passed the test.

At my next position I was fortunate to attend  my first and only SAP Academy training for Strategic Enterprise Management.  It was intense 2 weeks.  We even spent the weekend at the Atlanta SAP training office preparing.  I passed.

Years later, you could take SAP Certification courses at Pearson Learning Centers.  I studied for SAP Business Warehouse exam, drove to the Learning Center in Ashburn, Virginia on a Sunday morning, and passed.  I was so excited I took the wrong exit on the highway to return home.

I think it is a great way to learn to take the test.
